items.summary: Warren slammed Trump for trusting AI companies to regulate themselves, warning that voluntary safety commitments are no substitute.

items.headline: NVIDIA Customer AM Intelligence Seeks $3 Billion Financing for Processor Order

items.headline: UKO Microshops AG: Director's Dealings Notification
